mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS call_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS prompt_tokens, GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens - prompt_tokens), 0), 0) AS completion_tokens, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(user_id, '')) AS active_user_count FROM aigc_message WHERE

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS call_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS prompt_tokens, GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens - prompt_tokens), 0), 0) AS completion_tokens FROM aigc_message WHERE GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY stat_date ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aigc_knowledge WHERE (create_time < #{endTime} OR create_time IS NULL)

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aigc_model) AS model_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aigc_app) AS app_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aigc_knowledge) AS knowledge_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aigc_docs) AS doc_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aigc_conversation) AS conversation_count

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(model, ''), '未知模型') AS name, COUNT(*) AS call_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens FROM aigc_message WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(model, ''), '未知模型') ORDER BY total_tokens DESC, call_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(username), ''), NULLIF(MAX(user_id), ''), '未知用户') AS name, COUNT(*) AS call_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens FROM aigc_message WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), username) ORDER BY total_tokens DESC, call_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
